# ------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Aim 1: Data assembly for plotting
# ============================================================
# Assumes aim1_memory_power and aim1_cortical_power have already
# been created earlier in the script.

# Combine the two datasets
aim1_power_df <- bind_rows(
  aim1_memory_power,
  aim1_cortical_power
) %>%
  mutate(
    scenario = factor(scenario, levels = c("Conservative", "Moderate", "Optimistic")),
    outcome = factor(outcome, levels = c("Memory", "Cortical Thickness")),
    scenario_y = if_else(outcome == "Memory", power + 0.045, power + 0.020),
    power_y = if_else(outcome == "Memory", power - 0.035, power - 0.020)
  )

# Same publication-friendly colors used in Figure 2
pub_colors <- c(
  "Memory" = "#0072B2",
  "Cortical Thickness" = "#D55E00"
)

p1 <- ggplot(
  aim1_power_df,
  aes(x = rhoA, y = power, color = outcome, group = outcome)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3.2) +

  # Scenario labels above points
  geom_text(
    aes(y = scenario_y, label = scenario),
    size = 3.3,
    fontface = "bold",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  # Power labels below points
  geom_text(
    aes(y = power_y, label = scales::percent(power, accuracy = 1)),
    size = 3.1,
    color = "gray20",
    fontface = "bold",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0.80,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray35",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.64,
    y = 0.85,
    label = "80% power threshold",
    hjust = 1,
    size = 3.7,
    color = "gray30"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pub_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1.05),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.08))
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.18, 0.67), clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 1. Power to Detect Marker–Outcome Associations",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Power across assumed marker–outcome correlations for memory and cortical thickness. ",
      "Scenario labels are shown above points; estimated power is shown below points."
    ),
    x = "Assumed Correlation (r)",
    y = "Statistical Power",
    color = "Outcome",
    caption = "Memory and cortical thickness curves are shown using the same outcome colors as in Figure 2."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p1)
```

```{r cars}
aim2_power_df <- bind_rows(
  aim2_memory_power,
  aim2_cortical_power
) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome = factor(outcome, levels = c("Memory", "Cortical Thickness")),
    scenario = factor(scenario, levels = c("Small", "Moderate", "Large")),
    scenario_label = case_when(
      scenario == "Small" ~ "Small (\u0394\u03c1 = 0.15)",
      scenario == "Moderate" ~ "Moderate (\u0394\u03c1 = 0.25)",
      scenario == "Large" ~ "Large (\u0394\u03c1 = 0.35)"
    ),
    scenario_label = factor(
      scenario_label,
      levels = c(
        "Small (\u0394\u03c1 = 0.15)",
        "Moderate (\u0394\u03c1 = 0.25)",
        "Large (\u0394\u03c1 = 0.35)"
      )
    ),
    ratio_label = factor(
      ratio_label,
      levels = c(
        "Balanced (50/50)",
        "Moderate imbalance (60/40)",
        "High imbalance (70/30)"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "50/50 (A=0 / A=1)",
        "60/40 (A=0 / A=1)",
        "70/30 (A=0 / A=1)"
      )
    ),
    power_label_y = if_else(
      outcome == "Memory",
      pmax(power - 0.10, 0.03),
      pmin(power + 0.10, 1.02)
    )
  )

pub_colors <- c(
  "Memory" = "#0072B2",
  "Cortical Thickness" = "#D55E00"
)

p2 <- ggplot(
  aim2_power_df,
  aes(
    x = ratio_label,
    y = power,
    color = outcome,
    group = outcome
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0.80,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray35",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3.2) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = power_label_y,
      label = scales::percent(power, accuracy = 1)
    ),
    size = 4.0,
    color = "gray20",
    fontface = "bold",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~scenario_label, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pub_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1.05),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.10))
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 2. Power to Detect Marker \u00d7 Amyloid Interaction",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Power to detect differences in correlations between amyloid groups ",
      "(A=0 vs A=1). Panels show interaction effect sizes defined by ",
      "\u0394\u03c1 = \u03c1(A=1) - \u03c1(A=0); point labels show estimated power."
    ),
    x = "Amyloid Group Balance",
    y = "Statistical Power",
    color = "Outcome",
    caption = "A=0: amyloid-negative; A=1: amyloid-positive"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, margin = margin(b = 6)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines"),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 25, 15, 15)
  )

print(p2)


```

)
